brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: One full hex base (piece:0,0,0) with a plain full-face cover on top (cover;top) and bottom (cover;bottom), and six solid caps on every side face (cap ×6). No open faces remain. check_build reports no rule issues and meshClash 'clear'.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: A hex-port-louvre port (port:0#0,0#0) is fitted on side slot 0 of the base. The louvre is designed to vent a closed cell without letting rain in. Caveat: the six caps were added around all side faces, and the tool did not report whether the port's face also carries a cap, so the vent is confirmed by the port's presence and the clear mesh check rather than by a visual check of the opening.

finish.summary: Built a closed single-cell enclosure: full hex base closed top, bottom, and all six sides, with one louvred port for ventilation. Mesh check clear, no rule issues. The louvre sits on one side face; I did not separately verify the opening is unobstructed by the side caps.
